meta.title: HKChat Cantonese Coach
meta.description: Learn real Cantonese: Jyutping six-tone breakdowns, Mandarin-to-Cantonese rewriting with particle explanations, scripted role-play (cha chaan teng, wet market, asking directions), weekly self-test with grading, and a practice log. Works offline on a built-in rule base; add a HKGAI developer key to have the HKGAI Cantonese model behind HKChat answer instead.
